summary: Fate entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Fate/stay night
entries.definitive_edition: Fate/stay night Remastered on Windows PC for modern archive play

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; use console hardware/emulation only for Realta Nua version comparisons.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC remaster at current patch level

primary.why: The 2024 remaster is the current official PC route, based on the Realta Nua version and adding HD presentation plus official English and Simplified Chinese localization. The 2004 PC original remains a historical route because content and presentation differ.
primary.how_to_play: Use Fate/stay night Remastered on Steam for the main archive route. Record language, route order, flowchart/progress state, and whether the goal is the modern all-ages remaster or the original 2004 adult PC release.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Japanese PC release and historical content baseline.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical route; use only if preserving the original 2004 release specifically.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 2 / PlayStation Vita Realta Nua lineage
all_releases.fidelity: All-ages console lineage that the remaster is based on.
all_releases.reason: secondary: useful for version comparison, but superseded for normal English PC archive play by the remaster.

all_releases.fidelity: Current official HD and localized route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current official route, with PC preferred for capture.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remaster is the practical current route, but it is not the same artifact as the 2004 adult PC original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document whether the run targets the Remastered/Realta Nua lineage or the original 2004 PC release.
